title: Custom eggless cakes for Tallawong families — free parking at Riverstone
summary:
Riverstone Shopping Centre has a free car park. That matters when you're holding a cake, not a bag of groceries.

Circling for a spot with a cake on your lap is its own kind of stress. Free parking here removes it — which is why families as far as Tallawong make the drive.

100% eggless, always. Six sizes, 15 flavours, any custom design. Buttercream, fondant or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
